name: Meltdown Box
design_intent:
HEADLINE COLLAPSING ARENA / LAST-ONE-FLYING (v6_party_gimmicks_circuits.md §2.8; owner headline archetype). An enclosed demolition box: a full floor of destructible_blocks + two destructible wall columns that PROGRESSIVELY ERODE on a telegraphed, SYMMETRIC timed cascade until there is NO standable ground left -> a pure jetpack-survival scramble over the void. Last one still flying wins; everyone else falls off-screen into the exposed void.

FANTASY: 'the floor is disappearing under everyone -- stay in the air and be the last one flying.' The level itself removes the ground and dares you to fly (Pillars 2 no-standing + 4 death-is-cheap-and-funny, taken to the limit).

HOW IT'S BUILT (composed from Batch-1 destructible_block only -- no new mechanic): the floor is 8 destructible_block segments (x0..2400 @ top1080, w300 h140, trampoline tier so bouncing to gain height is the skill) each with break_on 'timed'. They erode OUTER-ROWS-FIRST, symmetric pairs on the same schedule: edge pair (x0,x2100) at t3.0s, then (x300,x1800) t4.5s, (x600,x1500) t6.0s, center pair (x900,x1200) t7.5s -- so the safe footing shrinks continuously toward center and is GONE by ~7.5s (climax lands around the ~10s stage TTL). Two trampoline wall columns (x-180 and x2400, h680) contain the early bounce-fight and erode LAST (t8.5s), completing the 'box fully dissolved' read. Every block telegraphs its break with growing CRACKS + a SHUDDER + a hazard-red flash for telegraph_s=1.0s BEFORE it vanishes (fairness rule §2.0#2 -- you SEE where the floor goes next and flee upward/inward). All arm off EventBus.combat_started, so the countdown/intro never erodes the box early.

FAIRNESS (§2.8, the ruling's key point): fair NOT because it's recoverable, but because EVERYONE'S floor erodes on the SAME schedule, SYMMETRICALLY -- no player keeps ground another loses. The void beneath is the shared killer; flight is the shared escape. Spawns are symmetric on the intact floor. A healthy fuelled player boosts to stay aloft as the floor goes (700px of recovery sky under the floor: floor bottom y1220 -> bottom blast line y1920).

KILL IDENTITY (§2.0#4, credit unchanged): falls into the exposed void = off-screen ring-out kills via PartyMatch's existing bounds check -> kill(&"ring_out"). A rival who SMASHED you off just before your block broke is credited within the 6.0s window; a pure 'ran out of floor and couldn't stay up' fall is an UNCREDITED self-fall (killer=-1). QA NOTE (relaxed K1' per §2.8): expect a HIGH uncredited-self-fall share on this archetype BY DESIGN -- judge it against this note, NOT the standard >=88% void_is_floor target. Kills still happen via smash-offs during the early bounce-fight + the opening void as the box collapses.

BACKDROP: open_sky, clouds off, dusty demolition-site palette (grey-brown) -- reads as a crumbling box, not a meadow. The void render (dark bottomless gradient + receding dirt canyon walls + under-lip AO + matte hazard-red rim/chevrons + falling motes) marks the whole bottom unmistakably lethal.
